name: handoff
description: At 250k tokens, offers Refresh: writes a handoff of the whole chat, shows the steps with progress bars, then copies it or starts a new chat with it. Logs every run to ~/.claude/handoffs/handoff.log and saves a draft first

offer.title: Refresh offer
offer.description: auto shows the Refresh row once the chat reaches offer_at tokens; off never offers it (/refresh and /handoff still work)

offer_at.title: Offer at (tokens)
offer_at.description: Context size at which the Refresh row offers a handoff
